name: Gnashing Of Teeth
overview: The phrase 'gnashing of teeth' in Scripture vividly portrays the intense anguish and hostility experienced by the righteous at the hands of the wicked, as seen in Job's suffering and David's psalms. The wicked are described as plotting and expressing rage through gnashing, reflecting their deep resentment and opposition to God's people. This imagery also conveys the ultimate frustration and despair of the ungodly, who will witness their desires perish and be grieved, emphasizing the justice of God against evil.
